_readme: Sourced court facts for city pages. The renderer ignores keys that start with _. A fact is included only when the cited page or OpenStreetMap element was retrieved and actually said it. Null dataset fields, OSM surface=other with no surface tag, and deleted OSM ways are listed under _omitted and are not rendered.

_omitted.why: No surface, lights, indoor/outdoor, or open-play value on these cities' publishable court rows was confirmed on a live OpenStreetMap element or a city/park page retrieved for this change. Garden Grove had surface=concrete on a row with no source_ref, and on OpenStreetMap way 1354311033, which now returns HTTP 410. Those surfaces were left out. Court counts already printed on the pages were not given a new writeup.

The courts dataset has indoor=false and lights=false. Live OpenStreetMap way 346937133 (the Beach & Tennis Club pitch) has no lit or indoor tag. Way 333435460 is building=commercial named Pickleball Haven and also has no lit or indoor tag. False was not published.

The courts dataset has indoor=true. OpenStreetMap way 83201240 does not. The City of Costa Mesa page lists pickleball on the open-gym schedule and, separately, rental of the Indoor Gym. It does not say the pickleball session is indoors or how many courts it uses, so indoor and a court count were not stated as city facts. The schedule was.

_omitted.why: Portola Park (way 1466666973), College Park (way 1472140216), North Lake Tennis Club (way 1306678787), and Galaxy View Park (way 1471513198) have no surface tag on the live OpenStreetMap way. surface=other was not published.

venues: Mike Ward Community Park reservation split from the February 4, 2026 news article
_omitted.why: That article says two courts would be reservable from 8 a.m. to noon and 4 p.m. to 10 p.m., two courts would be held for programming, and four courts would be drop-in from dawn to 10 p.m. The current City of Irvine pickleball page says courts 3 and 4 are reservable from 7 a.m. to noon and 4 p.m. to 10 p.m., and does not repeat the programming split or the dawn hours. The February schedule was not republished.

The pickleball page's Irvine Team Pickleball block lists 900 Tomato Springs, Irvine, CA 92618. The park page and OpenStreetMap way 1081065636 both list 92620. The ZIP from the league block was omitted. The league's format, fee, director, and self-rating describe a contract league, not the public courts, so they were omitted.

The pickleball page lists eight lit courts at Mike Ward, six at Portola Springs, four at Heritage, and two at Los Olivos, plus 10 hybrid courts across seven parks. Court Regulations and Map says 12 public pickleball courts and eight or nine hybrid courts, and it does not list Heritage's four dedicated courts. Those citywide totals disagree, so none of them were published.

The directory files Pickleball Courts at Portola Springs Community Center under Garden Grove with a count of 8. The City of Irvine park page says 6 lighted courts, and way 1081065636 has no courts tag, so the directory 8 was not copied onto the Irvine fact.

lines.text: A city news article dated February 4, 2026 says the city celebrated the opening of eight new lighted pickleball courts at Mike Ward Community Park — Woodbridge with a ribbon-cutting on Tuesday, February 3. It says four shade structures, picnic tables, benches, and hydration stations were installed, and that lighting improvements, restroom upgrades, and landscape and irrigation work were completed. It also says the courts are enclosed with a sound-dampening barrier.

The city's pickleball page says reservations are available for courts 3 and 4. Residents may book up to five days ahead and non-residents up to three days ahead, online at yourirvine.org. The page lists a resident rate of $17 per hour and a non-resident rate of $19 per hour, in one- or two-hour increments, one reservation per person per day, Monday through Sunday from 7 a.m. to noon and from 4 p.m. to 10 p.m. Those two courts can be used for drop-in play when they are not reserved or when a reservation does not show. Reservations are nonrefundable except for inclement weather, and they are for non-commercial use. For general pickleball questions the page lists 949-724-6417 and pickleball@cityofirvine.org.

The park page lists 6 lighted pickleball courts at Portola Springs Community Park, 900 Tomato Springs, Irvine, CA 92620. It lists the park at about 32 acres, phone 949-724-6192, and hours 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily.
lines.source: City of Irvine, Portola Springs Community Park

lines.text: OpenStreetMap way 1081065636 is named Portola Springs Community Park, with operator City of Irvine and the address 900 Tomato Springs, Irvine, CA 92620. The way has no sport, courts, or lit tag, so the court count and the lights are taken from the city park page, not from this way.

The city's pickleball page also says Portola Springs Community Park has six lit pickleball courts, and that reservations are available for courts 5 and 6 on the same terms as Mike Ward courts 3 and 4: five days ahead for residents, three days ahead for non-residents, $17 per hour for residents and $19 per hour for non-residents, one or two hours, one reservation per person per day, Monday through Sunday from 7 a.m. to noon and from 4 p.m. to 10 p.m., and drop-in play when the court is not reserved or a reservation does not show.

The same page says there are 10 hybrid tennis and pickleball courts at Heritage, Knollcrest, Los Olivos, Portola Springs, San Carlo, Turtle Rock, and University. It does not say how many of those 10 are at Portola Springs.
